name: siscoprint-chat-lambda
description: AWS Lambda chatbot backend powered by OpenAI + Supabase for Siscoprint

scripts.zip: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path function.zip) { Remove-Item function.zip }; Compress-Archive -Path index.mjs,lib,node_modules,package.json,package-lock.json -DestinationPath function.zip"
scripts.deploy: npm run zip && echo 'Upload function.zip to your Lambda function'
